name: Milestone timeline · weekly axis, described
purpose: A full-width weekly axis with each major milestone's diamond on its exact date. Each milestone carries its number, date, name and a one- or two-sentence description in aligned columns that alternate above and below the axis, with phase spans and date ranges across the top. One Magenta diamond marks the most important milestone.
